_comment: Public-signal layout for every circuit. THIS FILE IS THE CONTRACT between
the circuits, the backend verifier and the SDK. snarkjs emits publicSignals
as a flat array of strings with no names attached, so if these indices drift
from the .circom sources the backend will silently read the wrong field —
e.g. mistake a pincode for an age threshold — and still report the proof as
cryptographically valid. It would be a correctness bug with no error message.
Order is fixed by circom: public OUTPUTS first (in declaration order), then
public INPUTS (in declaration order). Regenerate with scripts/check_layout.mjs,
which asserts these against freshly generated proofs; tests/test_layout.py and
the circuit tests both fail if they disagree.

age_proof._note: issuer_pubkey_ax/ay added when the signature_valid stub was replaced by an in-circuit EdDSA issuer-credential check — see circuits/src/helpers/issuerCredential.circom and docs/UIDAI_INTEGRATION.md. Regenerate the age_proof verification key and re-run scripts/check_layout.mjs after recompiling.

location_proof._note: issuer_pubkey_ax/ay added when the signature_valid stub was replaced by an in-circuit EdDSA issuer-credential check over (state_code, district_code, pincode, secret) — see IssuerCredentialCheckN(3) in circuits/src/helpers/issuerCredential.circom.

citizenship_proof._note: issuer_pubkey_ax/ay added when the signature_valid stub was replaced by an in-circuit EdDSA issuer-credential check over (secret) only — see IssuerCredentialCheckSecretOnly() in circuits/src/helpers/issuerCredential.circom.

compound_proof._note: issuer_pubkey_ax/ay added when the signature_valid stub was replaced by an in-circuit EdDSA issuer-credential check over (dob_year, dob_month, dob_day, state_code, district_code, secret) — see IssuerCredentialCheckN(5) in circuits/src/helpers/issuerCredential.circom.

pan_proof._note: issuer_pubkey_ax/ay added when BOTH the signature_valid and pan_linked stubs were replaced by a single in-circuit EdDSA issuer-credential check over (pan_hash, secret) — see IssuerCredentialCheckN(1) in circuits/src/helpers/issuerCredential.circom. There is no separate pan_linked signal any more; the credential's existence is the linkage attestation.
